name: nonApi_ensureTrackAttendance
description: Internal, no auth. Gives a runner an At Hash attendance row on a run (James, 2026-09-10: every runner who has a track has an attendance row). The write mirrors a fresh At Hash check-in from hcapp_setEventAttendence (AttendenceState 20, RsvpState 3, IsHare 0, VirginVisitorType 0) and the run counts are recomputed the same way. No row → inserted ('inserted'); a live row below At Hash (an RSVP, a No) → raised to At Hash / RSVP Yes ('raised'); a live row already >= 20 → untouched ('rowExists'); only removed rows → untouched, an admin's removal is not undone ('rowExists'); deleted/missing hasher → 'noHasher'; deleted/missing run → 'noEvent'. Callers: the nightly track archive (api/Endpoints/ArchiveTrack.cs, TrackArchiver / ArchiveTracksNightly) for a hasher with points but no row; the track-import processor (TrackImportProcessor.cs) for every imported activity (2026-09-11); and HC6.hcapp_addDownDown via INSERT…EXEC when the run/kennel has CanEditRunAttendence = 1 — entering a charge checks you in (2026-09-12).

parameters.name: eventId
parameters.description: The run the trail belongs to. Must exist and not be deleted.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The runner. Must exist and not be deleted.

columns.name: Inserted
columns.description: 1 when a row was created, else 0.

columns.name: Reason
columns.description: 'inserted' | 'raised' | 'rowExists' | 'noHasher' | 'noEvent' (varchar literals; hcapp_addDownDown captures it as NVARCHAR(20)).

sideEffects: INSERT one HC.HasherEventMap row (AttendenceState 20, RsvpState 3, IsHare 0, VirginVisitorType 0, KennelId from HC.Event, updatedAt GETDATE()) when none exists, under UPDLOCK/HOLDLOCK on the existence check — or UPDATE the live row to AttendenceState 20 / RsvpState 3 when it is below 20. Either fires the HEM triggers: the row syncs to the runner's devices and nonApi_refreshEventActivity runs.
EXEC HC6.nonApi_updateRunCountsByUser @userId after COMMIT, outside the transaction (as hcapp_setEventAttendence does) — the runner's run counts change.
On any runtime error inside the TRY: rolls back, INSERT HC.ErrorLog ('<unknown>', userId, eventId), THROW.

codeSmells.detail: @eventId and @userId (lines 2-3) have no SQL default. All three callers pass both, so no client reaches the unlogged 'expects parameter' error today.

codeSmells.issue: CATCH cannot log when called through INSERT…EXEC
codeSmells.detail: hcapp_addDownDown line 137-138 calls this SP as INSERT @checkIn EXEC …, which runs it inside the INSERT's transaction. A runtime error here hits ROLLBACK TRANSACTION (line 101), which is itself an error inside INSERT-EXEC (Msg 3915), and the HC.ErrorLog INSERT (lines 102-104) is lost with the statement. The call in addDownDown is also outside its TRY, so the Add Down Down request fails as an unlogged 500.

Lines 40-64 (existing-state lookup, hasher and event checks) run before BEGIN TRY. They are plain reads, but an error there (e.g. a deadlock victim during the nightly archive) leaves no HC.ErrorLog row.
If the row reaches >= 20 between the pre-check (line 40) and the UPDATE (line 86), the UPDATE touches 0 rows but the SP still returns Reason 'raised' and recomputes run counts. Harmless.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
